description: Ensures an unavailable, timed-out, or malfunctioning native checker produces a verification-unavailable (NO_RULE) or resource refusal (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED), never a mathematical certificate rejection (CERTIFICATE_MISMATCH).
negative_fixture: Checker binary not found or timed out, returning Refused(code=CERTIFICATE_MISMATCH) for a valid certificate.
positive_fixture: Checker binary missing returns Refused(code=NO_RULE); timeout returns Refused(code=BUDGET_EXHAUSTED). CERTIFICATE_MISMATCH reserved strictly for completed checks finding certificate defects.
